Flexible plans

# Choose the plan that best fits your needs

## Standard

Pay-as-you-go for early-stage teams

Free$150 in free usage

Core Functionality

- Parse API
- Extract API
- Edit API
- Split API
- 30+ Supported File Types
- Up to 5 seats for Reducto Studio
- No Page Limits

After your free $150, standard rates apply.

Most Popular

## Growth

Built for scaling teams

Custom pricing

Everything in Standard, plus:

- Volume Discounts
- Zero Data Retention Agreement
- Business Associate Agreement
- Premium Rate Limits and Priority Requests
- Priority Slack/Teams and Email Support
- EU/AU Data Residency Endpoints
- Unlimited Studio Seats

## Enterprise

Built for full control & custom needs

Custom pricing

Reducto Office SDK

Open, edit and render Word documents in your own app. $0.10 per session, pay as you go. A session is one document open for up to 60 minutes.

[Learn about the Reducto Office SDK](https://reducto.ai/office-sdk)

Migration credits

If you're using another document processor, we'll give you up to $5,000 in credits to migrate your workload to Reducto.

[Apply for migration credits](https://reducto.ai/migrate)

Reducto for Startups & YC

## Free credits and startup pricing

If you're an early-stage team building document processing into your product, our Startup Program gives you free credits and discounted Growth pricing to get to production faster.

[Explore the Startup Program](https://reducto.ai/startups)

Backed by Y Combinator? [Claim the exclusive YC deal](https://reducto.ai/yc)

- Free credits to test production document workflows
- Startup pricing on our Growth tier
- Priority support and a dedicated Slack channel

Startup Program Eligibility

- Under $15M in funding
- Under $3M in annual revenue
- Under 50 employees

###

Reducto uses per-product pricing based on what you process. Standard rates start at $1 per 1,000 pages for r-1 mini Parse, $10 per 1,000 pages for r-1 Parse, and $20 per 1,000 pages for Extract, with parsing included. Standard accounts include $150 in free credits.

For current rates and usage details, see our [Usage and Pricing](https://docs.reducto.ai/reference/credit-usage).
